subject: Clearline evidence package and delivery preferences
messages:
From: Sara Liao <sara.liao@clearlinehealth.com>
To: Kimberley Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
Cc: TrustAssure Audit <audit@trustassure.com>
Date: 2026-10-28T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: SOC2 evidence request — admin activity (initial scope)

Hi Kimberly,

We're kicking off Clearline's SOC 2 readiness review and TrustAssure asked us to collect a short, timeboxed admin activity bundle from Redwood. Attached is our current scope (clearline_soc2_scope.xlsx) — primarily operator/admin actions for the period 2026-07-01 to 2026-09-30.

High level ask: can you provide an export that includes what actions are logged (create/delete/role-change/privilege-escalation/keys-ops), the schema/field list, retention boundaries, and one delivery option (signed SFTP or presigned S3 with HMAC manifest).

Two things that are important to the auditor:
- canonical timestamps (UTC) with timezone normalization noted;
- attestation that PII is redacted or pseudonymized per the scope.

Can you confirm feasibility and an approximate ETA? We aim to start review the week of 2026-11-02.

Thanks,
Sara
Sara Liao
Compliance Manager, Clearline Health
From: Kimberley Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
To: Sara Liao <sara.liao@clearlinehealth.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-10-28T10:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: SOC2 evidence request — admin activity (initial scope)

Hi Sara — thanks for the scope doc, and welcome. We can produce a handback bundle that meets TrustAssure's needs. Quick summary of what we can include out of the box:

- event fields (we'll export as newline-delimited JSONL by default): timestamp_utc, actor_email, actor_id (pseudonymized if requested), action_type, target_type, target_id (pseudonymized), request_id, session_id, ip_address, region, outcome (success/fail), model_name, model_version, latency_ms, kv_cache_key (if operator interacted with cache), and retention_marker.
- retention policy notes: admin activity is retained for 365 days in the default tenant policy; we can run a historical snapshot for the requested quarter and provide it as an attested bundle.
- delivery options: signed SFTP with per-file HMAC, or presigned S3 with an HMAC-signed manifest and SHA256 checksums.

Questions for you to finalize scope:
1) Do you want pseudonymization of internal user IDs (we can replace with consistent hash tokens) or a full-redaction of email addresses?
2) Prefer Parquet (columnar) or JSONL/CSV? Parquet reduces size but auditors often want a straightforward JSON/CSV copy.
3) We will include timezone normalization to UTC and a small mapping doc for original zone if required.

Ben and Rishi, looping you in for retention/export mechanics and to confirm operator-action coverage. Marissa — can you own the auditor-facing timeline/attestation once we have technical details?

Kimberly Park
Security & Compliance Lead
Redwood Inference
From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
To: Kimberley Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>, Sara Liao <sara.liao@clearlinehealth.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-10-28T11:22:00-07:00
Subject: Re: SOC2 evidence request — admin activity (initial scope)

Hi all — technical clarifications from the serving/runtime side:

- Scope of "admin actions": our admin audit stream includes actions from Console UI, API (admin endpoints), and operator-run jobs (migration/rollouts). It does not include model input/output payloads by default.
- Format: we can produce both JSONL and Parquet. If you need fast inspector-friendly files, we recommend JSONL + gz compression. If you need analytics-ready schema, Parquet is available.
- Field list (example):
  * timestamp_utc
  * request_id
  * actor_email (or actor_token)
  * actor_role
  * action_type (e.g., ROLE_ASSIGN, DEPLOY_MODEL, SCALE_POOL, CONFIG_PATCH)
  * target_resource (string)
  * target_resource_type
  * model_version
  * node_pool
  * ip_address
  * region
  * outcome
  * duration_ms
  * kv_cache_key (nullable)
  * session_id
  * raw_request_snapshot_ref (pointer, if available)

- Delivery: we support SFTP + HMAC manifest or presigned S3. For SFTP we create a one-time user and rotate keys after transfer; we can provide an HMAC manifest file with SHA256 checksums and an overall signed manifest JSON.
- Timezones: all timestamps are stored in epoch-millis UTC in our logs; our export process will add an ISO-8601 timestamp_utc string for readability and include an origin_timezone field where relevant.

We estimate ~2 business days to generate the Q3 snapshot once scope is finalized and access method chosen. If Clearline wants pseudonymization, add one additional business day for tokenization and checksum attestation.

-ben
Ben Carter
Senior Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
From: Sara Liao <sara.liao@clearlinehealth.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Kimberley Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
Cc: TrustAssure Audit <audit@trustassure.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-10-29T08:17:00-07:00
Subject: Re: SOC2 evidence request — admin activity (initial scope)

Thanks Ben and Kimberly — this is helpful and aligns with what TrustAssure expects. A few clarifications from our side:

- Pseudonymization: please replace internal email addresses with consistent hashed tokens (we need to correlate multiple actions by the same actor, but cannot receive raw PII).
- File format: JSONL + gz is fine; include a Parquet derivative if it's not much extra work.
- Delivery: we prefer presigned S3 with an HMAC-signed manifest (our infra team will pull into their evidence bucket).
- Attestation: can Redwood provide a short signed statement (PDF) confirming the snapshot was generated from immutable logs, the hashing salt was not shared, and checksums match?

Last item: for the attestation and audit review we may need an example of timezone normalization — a 3-line sample extract in the manifest would help the reviewer.

ETA: target to receive the bundle by 2026-11-04 so TrustAssure can begin triage on 2026-11-05. Can you confirm by EOD?

Best,
Sara
From: Kimberley Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
To: Sara Liao <sara.liao@clearlinehealth.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-10-29T15:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: SOC2 evidence request — admin activity (initial scope)

Sara — confirmed. Plan and commitments below:

Deliverables (by 2026-11-04 EOD):
- Q3 admin activity snapshot (2026-07-01 to 2026-09-30) as JSONL.gz (primary) + Parquet (secondary).
- HMAC-signed manifest (SHA256 checksums) and short attestation PDF signed by our Compliance lead.
- Sample 3-line extract demonstrating timezone normalization and pseudonymization mapping (mapping uses salted SHA256 tokens; salt not shared).

Operational notes:
- We'll pseudonymize actor_email -> actor_token (consistent per-hash) using an internal-only salt and provide the mapping metadata (token prefix and hashing algorithm) in the attestation, not the raw salt.
- Retention statement: the raw admin stream is retained 365 days; this snapshot is an immutable export and we will provide a signed manifest attesting to immutability at creation time.
- Transfer: we'll generate a presigned S3 path and post the HMAC manifest to your indicated HubSpot record (CL-48922). Please confirm the S3 bucket name for ingest or the SFTP endpoint if you change preference.

Marissa will follow up with the auditor-facing cover note and DocuSign if the attestation needs a signature block.

Kimberly Park
Security & Compliance Lead
Redwood Inference
